headline: Executive order changes the rules for the National Defense Service Medal, an award given to members of the U.S. military.
what_it_does: This order amends an earlier order, Executive Order 10448, which created the National Defense Service Medal. The title says it changes that earlier order, but no summary was provided, so the specific changes are not described here. This medal is generally given to service members who serve during set periods of national emergency or conflict.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the U.S. armed forces
who_it_affects.how: The changes may affect which service members can receive the National Defense Service Medal, or for what periods of service.
